baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction joins the prohibited motion of tatghaw to al-mizan as the domain in which that motion occurs.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verb supplies movement past a proper limit, while the balance supplies a justice-bearing standard. The command therefore blocks an agent from crossing the equitable bound made operative by measurement.

activation_trace.role: Overstepping a proper bound supplies the prohibited motion and makes the violation directional rather than merely inaccurate.
The justice-bearing scale supplies the normative limit against which the overstep is detected.

changed_reading.before: Do not commit an unspecified excess around a scale.
changed_reading.after: Do not cross the just limit that the balance makes operative.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same root pair can couple a rising, overwhelming force with a balance that aligns terms against one another.
baseline_models.mechanism: An initial displacement can become a surge that erases the counterrelation needed for balance. The prohibition addresses runaway amplification, not only a single fraudulent act.

activation_trace.role: Overflowing force supplies a dynamic failure mode in which excess rises until it overwhelms its container or counterpart.
Alignment between two things supplies the relation that runaway force would destroy.

changed_reading.before: The command regulates deliberate cheating at a weighing event.
changed_reading.after: It also blocks runaway force that overwhelms a calibrated relation, even when the first displacement was small.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Tatghaw marks departure beyond a limit, while al-mizan can name aligned and proportioned created terms.
baseline_models.mechanism: Balance is not flat sameness. It is a relation among differently proportioned terms, and transgression occurs when one term is forced beyond the relation that lets the whole remain coherent.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant mapped root still supplies a clear act of exceeding the assigned limit.
Balancing or aligning counterparts makes the operative unit a relation rather than an isolated quantity.
Measured created proportion extends the relation from an instrument to the constitution of things.

changed_reading.before: Balance requires making all sides equal in amount.
changed_reading.after: Balance preserves fitting proportion, and transgression is forcing one member beyond its relation to the others.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The prohibition occurs inside the practice of weighing, whose branches include steady judgment and conferred standing, while the split transgression root includes false authority.
baseline_models.mechanism: A judgment can gain social weight and then mistake that weight for unquestionable sovereignty. The balance is therefore not automatically innocent; its users can turn assessment into coercive authority.

activation_trace.role: The false-authority branch supplies institutional capture as a form of transgression within measurement.
Steady, weighty judgment supplies the legitimate evaluative capacity that can be captured.
Standing or worth that carries weight supplies the social effect by which an assessment acquires authority.

changed_reading.before: The balance is a neutral instrument that only its measured object can distort.
changed_reading.after: Do not let a weighty judgment or institution convert its evaluative standing into transgressive sovereignty.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mercy opens the sequence, teaching makes things knowable, creation itself carries measuring, and bayan makes meaning manifest. This activates al-mizan as a learned and communicable discipline of proportion, so transgression can enter through framing and explanation before it reaches a physical scale.

activation_trace.role: Crossing the proper bound anchors the new epistemic reading in the focus prohibition.
Estimation and measurement supply a cognitive practice rather than only a market instrument.
Tender mercy supplies the normative atmosphere in which discernment is taught and exercised.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the transition from hidden order to apprehended measure.
Measuring and estimating within creation links proportion to how the human is constituted.
Clarifying meaning by speech or sign makes communicative framing part of the measuring mechanism.

structural_cues: 55:1-4 places mercy, teaching, human creation, and taught expression before the celestial and scale sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mercy, disclosure, creative measuring, and clarified meaning; I infer that their order gives measurement a compassionate epistemic genealogy. A live alternative is that these are parallel gifts and do not causally define al-mizan.

changed_reading.before: The verse regulates only an external device or transaction.
changed_reading.after: It also regulates the learned act of making proportions intelligible: do not overreach in how reality or another party is framed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Counted celestial recurrence, downward yielding, upward raising, and deliberate placing form a coordinated field of motion. The balance is the control relation within that field, and transgression is a force that drives one motion past the calibration sustained by the others.

activation_trace.role: A rising overwhelming force supplies the dynamic disturbance that the cosmic calibration must contain.
Alignment among terms anchors the control relation directly in al-mizan.
Counting and calculation supply repeatable celestial calibration rather than accidental coexistence.
Lowering and yielding supply a counter-motion to elevation and model ordered responsiveness.
Elevation supplies the upward vector in the spatial mechanism.
Placing something in a settled or lower position supplies the complementary downward vector.
A measured, proportioned created thing identifies the placed balance as an ordering condition.

structural_cues: 55:5-7 moves from celestial calculation and prostration to the opposed verbs of raising the sky and placing the balance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies calculation, lowering, raising, placing, and measured proportion; I infer that they compose a coordinated vertical system in which local excess propagates. The live alternative is simple juxtaposition of cosmic signs and an ethical command.

changed_reading.before: Do not falsify a local weighing operation.
changed_reading.after: Do not inject a runaway vector into the calibrated relations that hold an ordered field together.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next command does not merely repeat the ban on excess. It requires active maintenance of straight, equitable weight and separately prohibits shortfall, exposing two opposed failure modes: aggressive overreach and concealed subtraction.

activation_trace.role: Overstepping supplies the excess-side failure that the following verse complements.
Justice and equity in the scale anchor both corrective imperatives in one norm.
Repeated weight and balance supply an enacted measurement process with a result that can be checked.
Straightness, equilibrium, and rectitude make calibration an active maintenance task.
Justice and fair dealing specify the direction in which the scale must be maintained.
Shorting measure supplies the deficit-side distortion that is not captured by overflow alone.

structural_cues: 55:9 encloses qist and the ban on shorting between two occurrences of the weight/balance root.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies establishment, equity, repeated weighing, and shortfall; I infer that tatghaw and tukhsiru expose opposite distortions around a maintained center. A live alternative is that both prohibitions target overlapping forms of commercial fraud rather than a general two-sided system.

changed_reading.before: Balance is preserved by avoiding too much.
changed_reading.after: Balance requires active equitable calibration against both overreach and subtraction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same placing motion settles fertile earth for all terrestrial creation, then the text enumerates seed, crop residue, and plant life. The balance can therefore govern distribution across beneficiaries and across a regenerative material cycle, not only exchange between two traders.

activation_trace.role: Exceeding a proper limit anchors ecological or distributive overreach in the focus verb.
Measured created proportion allows al-mizan to organize material provision rather than only prices.
Settled placement carries the scale's preceding spatial logic into the earth.
Fertile growing ground supplies the regenerative substrate whose measure can be exceeded.
Earth-dwelling creation supplies a plural beneficiary set rather than a single owner.
Seed that grows and bears grain supplies renewal within the provision cycle.
Husk and fragmented crop leaf supply the usually discounted remainder of the same yield.
Plant and leaf imagery completes a living material cycle rather than a bare commodity count.

structural_cues: 55:10 follows the scale command with earth placed for al-anam, and 55:11-12 inventories fruit, grain, residue, and vegetation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies common beneficiaries, fertile ground, seed, residue, and plant life; I infer a distributive and regenerative constraint on use. A live alternative is that the list celebrates provision without specifying resource governance.

changed_reading.before: The prohibition protects accuracy in bilateral exchange.
changed_reading.after: It can also restrain appropriation that excludes co-beneficiaries or consumes a shared regenerative order faster than it can bear.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two abundant waters are released into contact, yet an interval prevents either from aggressing, and valued material emerges from them. Balance becomes a permeable boundary that permits meeting and production while blocking domination, rather than a wall of total separation or a demand for fusion.

activation_trace.role: Surging beyond bounds supplies the hydraulic failure that the two-seas scene makes concrete.
Alignment between counterparts supplies the relational form of the boundary.
Mixing and disorder supply active interaction and the risk of losing distinction.
Vast abundant water gives the transgressive surge a material scale.
Two opposed things arriving together supplies contact without requiring sameness.
The interval between two things supplies a relational middle where separation and connection coexist.
Aggressive boundary-crossing names the domination that the interface prevents.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies an output generated at or through the maintained relation.

structural_cues: 55:20 inserts barzakh between the meeting seas; it is used here only as an uncited structural partition.
55:22 follows non-aggression with the emergence of pearl and coral.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies release, meeting, an interval, non-aggression, and subsequent emergence; I infer that bounded contact enables output rather than merely preventing collision. A live alternative is that the emergence is a neighboring sign, not a causal result of the boundary.

changed_reading.before: Balance is static equality or strict separation.
changed_reading.after: Balance is a managed interface where different forces can meet and generate value without either overrunning the other.

context_deltas.mechanism: The addressed communities are named through weight, acquired conduct becomes an identifying mark, and recognition leads to being held for guilt. Al-mizan can therefore be a process that turns carried moral or social weight into legible accountability.

activation_trace.role: Overstepping supplies the conduct whose accumulated consequence becomes accountable.
Standing or worth that carries weight lets weighing attach to persons and communities.
Accounting of deeds supplies the evaluative procedure linking weight to responsibility.
Weight that is precious or carries standing makes the two addressed kinds bear evaluative gravity.
Acquisition supplies conduct as something accumulated or carried rather than an abstract label.
A visible identifying trace supplies the conversion of hidden accumulation into legible evidence.
Being held to account for guilt supplies the terminal consequence of the evaluative process.

structural_cues: 55:31 addresses al-thaqalan, while 55:41 sequences recognition by marks and apprehension.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies weighty addressees, acquisition, visible marking, and accountability; I infer that the mark externalizes what agents have accumulated for evaluation. A live alternative is that these are separate epithets and punishment details with no implied weighing process.

changed_reading.before: The balance measures objects external to the agent.
changed_reading.after: The balance can make the weight agents acquire through conduct legible and answerable.

context_deltas.mechanism: Passage through a boundary is made conditional on sultan, whose branches keep compelling proof and jurisdictional power simultaneously live. This revises the focus ban from a rejection of every crossing into a test of warrant, while the false-authority branch warns that claimed warrant can itself capture the test.

activation_trace.role: Transgressive false authority supplies the danger that a purported warrant becomes its own exemption.
Steady judgment supplies the capacity that tests whether passage is warranted.
Clean passage to the other side supplies literal boundary crossing as the act under evaluation.
Compelling proof supplies epistemic warrant for crossing.
Power and jurisdiction supply the coexisting institutional sense of warrant.

structural_cues: 55:33 repeats the passage verb in challenge, command, negation, and exception around a single sultan condition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies conditional passage plus proof and power branches; I infer a jurisdictional analogy in which the balance audits warrants. A live alternative is that 55:33 is only an eschatological challenge and offers no general rule for legitimate crossing.

changed_reading.before: Any movement beyond a boundary is transgression.
changed_reading.after: Crossing can be warranted, but the balance must test the warrant and resist its conversion into coercive self-authorization.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two springs flow and every fruit appears in paired kinds. The balance's alignment branch becomes generative complementarity: coordinated counterparts preserve distinction while producing abundance, so equality is not the erasure of difference.

activation_trace.role: Exceeding the relation supplies the threat to coordinated counterparts.
Balancing and aligning two things directly supplies the paired architecture.
A flowing water source supplies each side of a productive pair.
Continuous flow makes the paired relation active rather than decorative.
A counterpart joined to its counterpart supplies complementarity without identity.

structural_cues: 55:46-52 repeats dual garden, dual spring, and paired-fruit forms.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dual sources, flow, and paired kinds; I infer that their repeated coordination instantiates balance as productive complementarity. A live alternative is that duality only intensifies abundance and is not a model of al-mizan.

changed_reading.before: Balance means reducing unlike terms to one equal unit.
changed_reading.after: Balance can coordinate unlike counterparts so that their maintained difference becomes productive.

context_deltas.mechanism: Good action is answered by good through a branch of recompense that matches an act with its consequence. The balance shifts from numerical equality to fitting response: what returns corresponds in kind and moral quality to what was done.

activation_trace.role: Overstepping anchors the possibility of breaking a fitting reciprocal relation.
Mental and relational equivalence supplies correspondence without requiring identical quantities.
Answering an act with its recompense supplies the return path in the reciprocal mechanism.
Good action on both sides supplies the moral quality that remains aligned across response.

structural_cues: 55:60 repeats ihsan on the action and response sides of a compact rhetorical equation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies act-to-recompense correspondence and repeated good action; I infer that this is an ethical realization of balance. A live alternative is that the verse praises divine generosity without proposing a general reciprocal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Balance returns an equal quantity for an equal quantity.
changed_reading.after: Balance can return a fitting moral response whose correspondence is qualitative rather than arithmetical.

context_deltas.mechanism: The positive garden scene contains paired springs whose water gushes abundantly. This weakens the baseline equation of forceful flow with transgression: force becomes taghy only when it breaches a fitting relation or overruns its bounds.

activation_trace.role: Overflowing force supplies the baseline sense now being qualified rather than discarded.
Relational alignment supplies the criterion distinguishing vigorous flow from destructive excess.
A water source situates the force within a bounded and life-giving channel.
Water that gushes and increases supplies a positively framed counterexample to treating intensity itself as violation.

structural_cues: 55:66 places two gushing springs inside the affirmative paired-garden sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies abundant gushing in a positive bounded setting; I infer that violation depends on breached relation, not raw intensity. A live alternative is that the gush is plentiful but never approaches the out-of-bounds surge carried by taghy.

changed_reading.before: Any strong surge is already a transgression of balance.
changed_reading.after: Vigorous abundance can remain balanced; the prohibited surge is force that overruns its relation, channel, or counterpart.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing branch joins stability with increasing good. Read back onto al-mizan, equilibrium need not be sterile or zero-sum; a measured order can remain grounded while enabling sustained increase, whereas taghy is growth that loses its governing relation.

activation_trace.role: Uncontained increase supplies the contrast to growth that remains stable.
Measured created proportion supplies the stable ordering condition for growth.
Good that is both fixed and growing supplies a dynamic alternative to static equilibrium.

structural_cues: 55:78 closes the surah after repeated scenes of bounded pairs, flow, recompense, and provision.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies stable increasing good at the close; I infer that this qualifies balance as sustainable growth and distinguishes it from runaway increase. A live alternative is that the closing blessing does not retrospectively define al-mizan.

changed_reading.before: Balance is a static midpoint that suppresses increase.
changed_reading.after: Balance can be stable, generative order; transgression is increase severed from the relation that sustains it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the idiom of the day's balance standing at midpoint rather than the ordinary scale sense, and 55:29 never explicitly mentions weighing. It remains anchored in an exact WZN focus branch plus packet branches for a bounded day and a renewed affair. Downstream prose should present it only as a temporal analogy of recurrent recalibration, not as a translation of 55:8.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus balance has a packet branch for the day reaching its midpoint, and the prohibition supplies the danger of passing a fitting temporal center.

activation_trace.role: Crossing the proper limit supplies the motion past a temporal center.
The day's balance at midpoint supplies a literal temporal calibration branch.
A bounded daytime interval supplies the recurring unit within which a center can be found.
A renewed matter or state supplies changing content that requires recalibration rather than a once-for-all setting.

changed_reading.before: A correct balance is fixed once and remains correct without attention.
changed_reading.after: Each bounded interval and changed affair may require finding the center again without driving past it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it uses the rare non-dominant noise branch for TGHY and the sharp-tongue branch under a source occurrence whose immediate sense is sultan. It remains formally anchored in the mapped focus root, the balance's social-weight branch, bayan, and the packet's live tongue image. Downstream prose must label it a speculative rhetorical warning and must not replace the ordinary senses of tatghaw or sultan with noise or speech.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The split focus root can evoke collective noise while the balance can assign standing or weight, creating a question about whether forceful expression is being mistaken for merit.

activation_trace.role: Voice or collective noise supplies rhetorical force that can crowd out measured judgment.
Standing or value that carries weight supplies the status that noise may falsely acquire.
Clarification by speech or sign supplies the legitimate communicative function against which mere volume is distinguished.
A sharp clamorous tongue supplies a context activation in which verbal force imitates authority.

changed_reading.before: Forceful assertion naturally carries evidentiary or social weight.
changed_reading.after: Do not let volume, repetition, or a domineering tongue acquire weight that measured judgment has not earned.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates a nominal sense of a small detached portion from the non-dominant TGHY mapping against the focus verb. It remains anchored by that exact mapped branch, WZN estimation, contextual counting, and a whole-completeness cue. Downstream prose should render it as an epistemic sampling analogy, never as the lexical meaning of tatghaw in 55:8.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A detached portion from the split transgression root can be placed against al-mizan's estimation branch, making the prohibited overreach an inference from fragment to whole.

activation_trace.role: A small detached portion supplies the sample whose evidentiary reach may exceed its size.
Estimation and appraisal supply the inferential operation performed on the sample.
Counting and calculation supply a disciplined check on extrapolation.
Wholeness and complete encompassment supply the total that a detached sample must not impersonate.

changed_reading.before: Any measured portion can safely stand for the whole being appraised.
changed_reading.after: Do not let a detached sample overrun its evidentiary measure and masquerade as the whole.

strongest_changes: 55:9 revises a one-sided excess model into active calibration against both overreach and shortfall.
55:19-22 changes static balance into a permeable boundary that permits contact and emergence without domination.
55:31-41 extends weight from objects to agents, acquired conduct, visible evidence, and accountability.
55:66 weakens the claim that strong flow is inherently transgressive by showing abundant force within a paired, positive setting.
summary.what_was_special: The split TGHY mapping kept several readings alive at once: ordinary limit-crossing, hydraulic runaway, institutional capture, and contained noise or fragment outliers. Context then activated cosmological, commercial, ecological, legal, reciprocal, and rhetorical mechanisms without forcing them into one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet sequences strongly invite causal models, but several sequences may be juxtaposed signs rather than explanations of al-mizan.
The sea and garden structures may instantiate balance, or they may function only as analogies discovered by the reader.
The authority reading depends on extending the sultan challenge into a general test of warrant.
The noise, temporal-midpoint, and detached-fragment readings remain deliberately form-distant and require explicit qualification.
